NewsArticle.Title: Sapphire Stream Monastery Enhancements
NewsArticle.Content:
- Meditation sacrifices labor instead of the meditator's life when performed imperfectly.
- Appropriately challenging items required for crafting belt occurs much more frequently.
- Grade/Dugon Labor requirements lowered.
- Experience is not required when advancing Grade or crafting Dugon, if learned from an Aisling Sabonim.
- Higher Grade monk may enter lower grade Grove.
- Hali, the Undine merchant nearest to the Monastery, provides labor.
- Aisling Sabonim may assist Dugon crafting.
- Minor layout enhancement.
- Several new meditation mantras.
